title: The migration: OrganizationPortalSettings, one additive table

migration.note: One new table and one back-relation on Organization. No column is added to an existing table, nothing is renamed, nothing is dropped and no existing column gains NOT NULL. infra/deploy.sh:27 states the order this run must survive: 'Migrations run BEFORE the rollout, and the order is the whole point' — infra/migrate.sh runs `prisma migrate deploy` as a one-off task on the new image before Terraform rolls the services, so the table exists before any code queries it. The additive shape is what makes the reverse safe too: rolled-back code simply never selects a table it does not know about, and REQ-01-049 reads the table's absence, and every organization's absent row, as all three groups enabled — so the migration backfills nothing and signup is not amended.

detail: model OrganizationPortalSettings { id String @id @default(uuid()); organizationId String @unique; peopleEnabled Boolean @default(true); hiringEnabled Boolean @default(true); workEnabled Boolean @default(true); updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt; organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade) }, and the matching back-relation on Organization. The @unique on organizationId is what makes REQ-01-051's create-or-update a single-row upsert. Follow the directory convention of apps/api/prisma/migrations — the last one recorded in the run's baseline is 20260907120000_time_off_02_holiday_sourcing.
